scope: Measure exact ordered native World inputs and baseline-restored redraws on TITAN.

timestamps.scope: Actual captured public World sequences through unchanged decode/ownedV5 handoff/resident consumption, ordered cold-to-complete replay on NVIDIA TITAN EGL. All-frame completion throughput includes disk acquisition, decode, handoff, native CPU, GPU drain and cold startup; one diagnostic hash follows timing. Optional extra replay restores the exact native baseline and reruns ordered native draws without advancing producers. Checkpoint mode performs per-phase diagnostic hashes outside operation timings and is not a throughput benchmark. No original engine pacing/simulation, command import/UI, Qt widget paint or scanout. Timestamp GPU intervals include CPU submission starvation; timestamp-disabled mode has only an end-of-stream completion marker.
